reviews.author: ken mev
reviews.text: Dr. Joe is amazing, I highly recommend coming to see him!

reviews.author: Doug Ryder
reviews.text:
I have been to New Leaf Hearing several times in the past due to hearing loss in my left ear from an inner ear virus. This hearing loss occurred in 2019 just before everything shut down due to the effects of Covid19. Julie took all of the precautions recommended and mandated for the virus. I felt safe there and commend her for being so concerned and thoughtful. Regrettably, at that time we could not find a hearing aid with which I was compatible so I elected not to proceed further with it.

Last year, 2025, my hearing had deteriorated so once again I went back to New Leaf Hearing to see if hearing aid technology had changed so I could find a compatible hearing aid. It has! This time I saw Joe, who discussed things in a way I could understand and was patient with me while I wavered on the issue. Finally, I decided to get a hearing aid and have been happy with it since.

I do appreciate the care, empathy and understanding New Leaf Hearing gives to all their customers!

reviews.author: Christopher Taaffe
reviews.text: My pup got hold of one of my hearing aids and chewed a bit on it. Dr. Joe did a Great  job cleaning and repairing it and tuned them up for me. The crew there is fantastic, I will be their patient from now on.

reviews.author: David Murrell
reviews.text: I called New Leaf Hearing clinic stressed and sleep deprived after ringing in my ears and not sure what to do.  Lisa was able to help me with an appointment right away and even called to walk through details.  Iris and Dr. Joe were incredible once I arrived.  They took me in, evaluated me, and helped me understand treatment options.  That night, I slept more soundly than because of the worries they put to rest.  I cannot thank them enough for their wisdom and counsel.

If you are looking for a compassionate audiologist, look no further than New Leaf Hearing!

reviews.author: Elizabeth McDowell
reviews.text: Julie and her team at New Leaf are simply the best. I’ve been seeing Julie since before she opened this practice (17+ years), and she’s eternally patient, kind, and empathetic.

reviews.author: Candy Frie
reviews.text: Everyone here is delightful, but I have to especially commend Julie for the care she gave me recently during a sudden hearing loss episode when her quick action and referral to my primary care doctor resulted in my getting immediate attention and medication preventing what could have been a total hearing loss.  Her and Joe's follow-up care were professional, caring, and most appreciated.

reviews.author: claudia hahn
reviews.text: Julie is wonderfull

reviews.author: Donna Cook
reviews.text:
New Leaf Hearing Clinic is just wonderful! Audiologist Dr. Joe Kraus was just so very kind, patient and thorough. He explained everything in detail and double checked all of the settings. I was very anxious about getting hearing aids but the office has a very calming vibe. The hearing aids I received were Starkey Livio 1600 RIC R that have all kinds of bells, whistles and features
I had my hearing tested at UC Health. Even the el cheapo ones offered there were $1400. The audiologist at UC Health provided the information for financial assistance through Hearing the Call. I never could have afforded The Starkey Hearing Aids on my own. Dr. Krause's explanations make them easy and simple to use!

reviews.author: Kip Raymond
reviews.text: I contacted New Leaf for an appointment based on the many favorable reviews and close proximity to my home. I asked Julie to review the settings on my Oticon Real 1 hearing instruments. I was curious why these brand new, state-of-the-art instruments still didn't sound good. She instantly spotted the problem. The settings in the Genie program--set by my previous audiologist--were incorrect. She quickly rectified the issue and the hearing instruments are now working well for me. I will return to Julie and her helpful staff for tweaks, hearing tests and future needs.

reviews.author: Michelle Hrad
reviews.text: I came in without an appointment and needed to get the tube replaced on my left hearing aid. Not only did Julie take me, she took me right away, replaced both tubes and filters, and pulled a chunk of wax out of my ear. Took virtually no time at all. 5 stars all the way!

reviews.author: Preston Lewis
reviews.text:
I couldn't be happier with my new hearing aids. I had known I needed them for years but I just kept putting it off. Julie was so helpful in explaining my particular hearing loss. I've been in construction for my entire adult life and the damage was actually from all the loud noises over the years with tools etc. It made so much sense because it wasn't that I couldn't hear people, it was that I couldn't understand what they were saying, (but I didn't realize that). Wow.....what a difference...I can now sit in a group of people and actually understand what they're saying from across the room. I went to a movie and I didn't have to use the headphones. I don't need closed caption on the TV anymore. My wife hardly ever has to repeat herself......Believe me, she really appreciates that!
My new hearing aids are able to "pair" with my iPhone so it's really easy to adjust or change the settings with my phone. I HIGHLY recommend Julie and Erin from New Leaf Hearing. This is literally one of the best things I have ever done for myself.

Sincerely,
Preston L.

reviews.author: Mark Harris
reviews.text: Julie and staff are so kind and caring. They serve me and my dad and we are both so very pleased with the service and professionalism at New Leaf.

reviews.author: Ruth West
reviews.text: I was well taken care of by Julie and feel confident she will help me with my hearing problem.  Great!

reviews.author: David Peters
reviews.text: New Leaf Hearing Clinic is the best hearing clinic around.   Very professional and very friendly. Will never go anywhere else. They are Great!!

reviews.author: K
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience here. I had some molds made for musician's earplugs made here (which were made into earplugs elsewhere). The initial plug did not fit quite right, but Julie (the audiologist) worked with me to get a new mold made, and had the replacement overnighted to me just in time for a music festival I was attending. Can't recommend this clinic enough.

reviews.author: Ann Zugschwert
reviews.text:
When my tinnitus kept getting worse I knew it was time to get my ears checked. Did not know where to go and then remembered the Dr. that my dad had seen.  Julie checked my hearing and tinnitus and fitted me with a hearing aid that not only helped my hearing, but also helped with the tinnitus.
She is very knowledgeable, and answers any and all questions.
I have and will continue to recommend her highly.
Thanks for helping me, Julie!

reviews.author: jayme mcrimmon
reviews.text: New Leaf gives "patient care" a new meaning. From the welcome you get from Erin at the front desk to the personalized care from Julie, you know right away that New Leaf goes above and beyond for their patients. Julie doesn't shy away from discussing options, which is great considering the lifelong investment. I didn't know what to look for in a hearing aid. Julie talked about different options and actually sized a couple during the first appointment. Talk about personalized care!. We were able to find the perfect hearing aid for me which meets my hearing needs. I would recommend New Leaf to anyone looking to buy a hearing aid. The honesty and care at this facility makes New Leaf the best! Thank you Julie!

reviews.author: Carole Wood
reviews.text: Now, I can hear the people whose voices are so small.  I'm delighted.  Julie is full of information and does not push.  Excellent experience with her.

reviews.author: Susan Mc
reviews.text: Julie is the best audiologist in the Denver Area and she has changed my life.  I don't say that lightly or to be dramatic.  It is absolutely true.   Julie is  compassionate, intelligent, caring, and she really listens.  She treats each of her clients with the utmost respect and works hard to find the best hearing solution for each of her clients.  She never tries to sell products that aren't needed and always provides options and alternatives.  She doesn't have a huge mark-up like other places do.  I have had a hearing loss all my life and I have a long list of audiologists I've seen and none hold a candle to Julie.  So many places tried to sell me very expensive products that I didn't need, or that wouldn't really work well for my hearing loss.  Unfortunately, there seems to be a lot of hearing aid SALES places who just want your money or just want to rip you off.  I can absolutely guarantee you that Julie is definitely not that way.

reviews.author: dan june
reviews.text: New Leaf Hearing Clinic has been a great help to me. I always get someone on the phone when I call, they are helpful responsive and Dr. Raney is a real pro in her approach to providing solutions. I would recommend New Leaf Hearing Clinic to anyone in need of this kind of service.

reviews.author: Susan Graving
reviews.text: New Leaf Hearing is an outstanding hearing center in Littleton, that offers a wide array of hearing services. Owner Dusty Jesson Is incredibly welcoming, knowledgeable, and professional. Her positive energy is felt  when you walk through the door. She explains everything in easy to understand detail and is more than happy to share on screen or print results of any testing you have done. For hearing aid maintenance or first time hearing testing or any hearing services at all, I highly recommend this exceptional patient oriented business!

reviews.author: Paul Banken
reviews.text: Very responsive, helpful, and knowledgeable. I like working with Dusty and the rest of the staff.

reviews.author: tim taga
reviews.text: I am very impressed with the level of care demonstrated by Dr. Jensen and the staff at New Leaf. There was no rush and every question was addressed regarding my hearing evaluation and what options I had available including doing nothing. To everyone who has hearing loss feeling comfortable that you’re not being ripped off to address something as important as you’re ability to communicate to those around you is as about important as anything and those who do not suffer from this cannot fully understand how it affects one’s life. I am still not sure what my next step will be but would recommend New Leaf to anyone concerned about whether they are suffering from hearing loss. Audiologists are more expensive than going to just a hearing center that has trained technicians but in my opinion it is certainly worth the consultation even if you have to pay for it out of pocket.

reviews.author: David Martinez
reviews.text:
I have been going to this office for several years now.  Dr. Dusty is extremely knowledgeable about tweaking and adjusting hearing aids.
I have been wearing hearing aids for 10 years or so, and Dr Dusty is the absolute best audiologist I have ever met.
I am a musician and VERY particular about my sound. She has totally met my extremely high expectations!

Their warm personalized approach was comforting after the frustrating experience I had with my previous provider. Sometimes a vivid contrast is gives you the most appreciation for true professionals. Dr. Dusty has fitted me with a better brand/solution of hearing aids and I am now very happy. Before working with the team at Columbine Hearing Care, I wasn't confident that I'd be happy with any hearing aids. I am pleasantly surprised and extremely pleased. Thank you!

reviews.text: Dusty did an absolutely amazing and thorough job.  I've had the VA test me several times and they gave me hearing aid but they never worked as they should have. reviews.text: I am very appreciative of Dusty adding me on her schedule after she had a cancellation. I also appreciate her explanation that she can service any VA provided hardware based upon her service fee structure.

reviews.author: Randy Leonard
reviews.text: I have been wearing hearing aids for over 30 years now, and in all that time I have NEVER had such advanced testing and fitting of a new hearing aid and hearing CARE as with Dr. Dusty at Columbine Hearing Care. Wish I had found her sooner, she is so head and shoulders above all the other audiologists I have ever visited. SO knowledgeable, warm, friendly and thorough as well! You will be glad if you visit Dr. Dusty, I assure you.

reviews.author: Susan Bryan
reviews.text: Caring and knowledge.

reviews.author: Maryana Alekson
reviews.text: It was great experience! Very professional staff, pays attention to details, has personal approach, listens and shares information with patient. The visit was pleasurable and useful at the same time.

reviews.author: Paul Colomy
reviews.text: Dr. Dusty at Columbine Hearing Care is a first-class audiologist. She is an extraordinarily competent professional while also being personable and kind. Initially, I was skeptical about hearing aids, but Dr. Dusty made me a believer. My new hearing aids have made my life qualitatively better: I hear things I missed before; I don't have to lean into people as they speak (which is sort of creepy) or ask them to repeat what they just said (which is pretty annoying); I've turned the volume on the TV way down; etc. And Dr. Dusty doesn't just sell hearing aids; she also provides exceptional and continuous service, making all the necessary adjustments to ensure that your new devices are working properly. If you're like me, spending a tidy sum on hearing aids probably doesn't rank high on your bucket list. But for me, it was money well spent.

reviews.author: Mark Davidson
reviews.text: I cannot say enough kind words of the exceptional experience I have had with Columbine Hearing Care. Truly a one of a kind and first class operation who have given me their personalized and thoughtful care with not only an emergency I experienced but also improving my hearing with new hearing aids. Columbine Hearing Care were the only Hearing Aid company who returned my call and Brenda immediately resolved my situation. Brenda is now working with me on evaluating my hearing loss and have presented me multiple options to include hearing aids with new AI technology. Brenda spends as much time as she feels necessary to make sure my hearing aid measurements are correct to my specific hearing requirements. Brenda and Columbine Hearing Care has gone above and beyond my previous ENT hearing aid provider, to include my expectations and satisfaction in making sure I am truly satisfied. I want to emphasize how much they care about their clients and guarantee their satisfaction. I highly recommend Columbine Hearing Care!

reviews.author: Loretta Gerk
reviews.text: The Audiologists are GREAT, especially Dr Dusty!!! I've been a patient at Columbine Hearing Care for a little over a year. Dr Dusty is professional, personable and knowledgeable. I had a hearing test at Mayo Clinic in Rochester, MN and was told I had mild hearing loss. I was hesitant and did not want to wear hearing aids and Dusty had the gift of putting me at ease. My experience with others in their office has been positive. They are all so kind and friendly!

reviews.author: Ardythe P
reviews.text: Columbine Hearing Care is truly amazing. They go 'above and beyond' every step of the way! I am so very grateful for them.

reviews.text:

I highly recommend Dr.Jessen and her team, they are a wonderful group of people.

reviews.author: Jessica Savitt
reviews.text: I came here thinking I had a hearing problem but actually thought they would tell me I was fine and to come back in 20 years when I REALLY need them. Turns out, I need hearing aids now to improve the clarity and to reduce the effects of tinnitus. Brenda explained all of the assessments and how hearing aids would benefit me. She is incredibly accommodating of my work schedule, and spends as much time as I need at appointments to help me feel comfortable with the hearing aids. I would recommend Columbine Hearing Care to anyone who thinks they may have a hearing deficit— it’s life changing!!

reviews.text: Truly a World-Class clinic, without exaggeration. Dr. Dusty is extremely knowledgeable, kind, and tremendous to work with. As a 30 year old who has had Hearing Aids all his life, I feel like they always have my back. Brenda and Joe are also top-class!!

reviews.author: Alan Sage
reviews.text: I’ve worked with Dr. Dusty for many years, and she’s awesome. She took the time to match me with the right hearing aid brand—one with long battery life—and was patient in helping me fine-tune the settings until they were just right. She’s always responsive and willing to do whatever it takes to make sure I’m happy, not just once but always. Highly recommend!

reviews.text:
The audiologist is professional, knowledgeable, and very friendly!
It was a pleasure to visit your office as I pass through to my home state.
Much appreciated the time and kindness that she showed while I had my office visit.
Thank you again for working me in so quickly.

reviews.author: S. Roth
reviews.text: Long time hearing aid user, and I had a very positive experience with Brenda while settling into my newest Resound hearing aids, R & L.  Very helpful and informative and really knowledgeable about these devices.  All in all, a very pleasant experience getting used to my new hearing aids.

reviews.author: Erika Panama
reviews.text: Their care is exceptional; they explain the procedure in detail. Dusty is super friendly. They made me feel very confortable.

reviews.author: Xoa Nguyen
reviews.text: Dr. Dusty provided exceptional care and service, ensuring my dad’s hearing aid fit perfectly and improved his quality of life—highly recommend!

reviews.author: Geoff Phillips
reviews.text: Dusty was amazing! She made me feel very comfortable, explained everything, and removed my ear wax blockage in minutes. The price was way better than any ENT but they have the same (or better) equipment. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Cameron Smith
reviews.text: I can hear again! Brenda was great - very knowledgeable, caring and did a great job cleaning out my ears. Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Pat and Carl Douhan
reviews.text: Dr Dusty is the best, most thorough audiologist I have ever worked with, and I have been wearing hearing aids for over 15 years.  I highly recommend her.

reviews.author: Ray Mumford
reviews.text: I contacted Columbine Hearing Care after a frustrating experience with another audiologist. Brenda did a complete exam and hearing tests. Throughout the process she explained what each test meant so I understood what my problems were. She gave me several options without trying to sell any of them. When the new devices arrived, she did the Real Ear Measurements adjusting the hearing aids specifically for my hearing issues. Which the previous audiologist did not do. Brenda has shown that she is truly concerned about my hearing health and wants to do everything she can to help me. I highly recommend Columbine Hearing Care.

reviews.author: David Skuodas
reviews.text: Went to see Dr. Dusty today for my first visit. What a great experience! There was free parking, no waiting, and very professional care. I thought I needed wax removal, but she very honestly told me why I don't and gave me solutions for what I was experiencing. I feel like she was trustworthy and sincere and truly just a lovely person. I would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Christine Enebo
reviews.text: After trying hearing aids TWICE and failing I was given Brendas name.  I was missing out on so much with my grandchildren...and was beginning to think this was the best my hearing was going to get.  Thank goodness I was WRONG!  I can hear the TV without running everyone out of the room with the volume at 100.  I can have conversations with people and not say 'excuse me? what did you say?' And they don't hurt my ears! Don't give in....you can hear again! Call this wonderful company...it will work...they are the best.

reviews.author: Tom Hollinshead
reviews.text:
I was confused and overwhelmed. My wife had  issued an edict that I either explore hearing assistance of some sort or else. I didn’t know whether I should go to a big box wholesale club, try OTC aids, find something online, or go to an ENT.

Then I realized that Dusty, with whom I volunteer for a nonprofit, is an audiologist, so I went to her. Best decision of my life. She and her co-star, Brenda, took incredibly good care of me, answering my many questions, and allowing me to test drive Unitron aids.

Through the process, I realized that the old adage about getting what you pay for is absolutely true when it comes to hearing. There are many variables involved with the selection and usage of hearing aids, and to try to save a few bucks by going to a big box store or OTC is absolutely not worth it. This is an investment in me and my quality of life that pays big dividends.

My hearing aids, or amps as I call them, are fantastic. It has not been difficult at all to get used to them and embrace them. I love that with Bluetooth technology for my amps I can make or receive phone calls, engage Siri, and even hear play calls from the Broncos huddle on TV. Just kidding about the last one. Most importantly, I hear things now so crisply and clearly where sounds before were just slightly muffled noises.

reviews.author: stephanie blocher
reviews.text:
Dusty is Amazing!  Columbine Hearing Care has the ability to test hearing even when people cannot sit in a booth.
My  mom is almost 93 years old, primarily wheelchair bound, but that didn't stop us from getting amazing test results and a new hearing aid along with new devices!
After 2+ years of yelling and frustration, even though we checked in with another hearing center for care, both my mom and I are exceedingly happy!!!

reviews.author: Linda
reviews.text: Dr Dusty did a very comprehensive hearing tests, advised us as to the best fit of hearing aids for my 90 year old mom, and took the time with her making her feel comfortable with them. I would highly recommend Columbine Hearing Care.

reviews.author: J Martin
reviews.text: Columbine Hearing Care, partnered with "Hearing the Call" for a 1-day event that I was blessed enough to be invited to attend. That event changed my life in a few short hours. The kindness, care, compassion, and expertise provided was overwhelmingly positive, and at the end of the day's free event, I had $0-cost, much-needed, high quality, fine-tune, wireless, battery less, barely detectable, stylish hearing aids, and a new audiologist who is absolutely wonderful at what she does!!! If you need a life change that involves the ability to hear clearly (affordably), contact Columbine Hearing,and apply for the Hearing the Call program if you need to--it will change your life.

reviews.author: Emma Lugo
reviews.text: Wonderful experience. All the staff was patient, understanding and professional.

reviews.author: the Chadwells
reviews.text: We have been going to Columbine Hearing Care for years. They provide 1st Class patient care and products. The hearing tests are the most comprehensive we have ever had. And, they offer a wide range of name brand top-of-the-line options.

reviews.author: Rob Madsen
reviews.text: This was the most thorough examination that I’ve had in 5 years from other audiologists.   Great experience w lots great results.

reviews.author: Sheri Rendon
reviews.text: Great experience! Dusty is friendly, knowledgeable and caring. She was very careful with my sensitive ear and got my hearing aid back into working order.

reviews.author: Tim C
reviews.text:
Dr. Dusty provided a high quality audiogram and better understanding of my hearing loss. The next step is hearing aids.

I am much more knowledgeable and comfortable with the process thanks to Dusty, and so looking forward to hearing better.

reviews.author: Danny Perez
reviews.text:
In the first of January  2024 I called and spoke with Lisa about getting an appointment to have an evaluation. Lisa set up the date and time for me  to be evaluated by Dr. "Dusty" and also emailed me a questionaire to fill out prior to my appointment.

I arrived at my appointment and Dr. Jessen was ready to start my evaluation. Everything I had spoken with Lisa about, plus all the information on the questionaire,  even my wife's first name,  she knew.

I could go on about the professionalism surrounding Columbine Hearing Care, however to keep this short. I'm very happy I chose Columbine for my care. I'm so satisfied with my hearing aids.

reviews.author: Phyllis Webb
reviews.text: If I could give more than 5 stars, I would.  I met Dr. Dusty by chance, and that was a truly lucky day for me.  I had struggled, unsuccessfully with 2 pairs of hearing aids that just didn't work for me,  so I was prepared to give up.  My first appointment with Dr. Dusty proved to be life-changing for me.  The time she took in testing and consulting was so appreciated, and I've ended up being able to hear like I haven't in many years.  My thanks doesn't seem enough!

reviews.author: Robert Lipp
reviews.text:
I recently moved my 95 year old father into my home and needed to get his hearing tested and discuss hearing aid options. Like most, I started my search online and liked what I saw with Columbine Hearing Care. I was able to schedule right away and got my father tested.

When we arrived I could immediately tell I came to the right place. Dr Dusty was attentive and professional. She listened to my our needs and within an hour had performed a battery of hearing tests.

It was clear my dad had lost virtually all his hearing; which I knew having had to yell every time we spoke. Dr Dusty fit him with a temporary set and everything changed. I about cried. I could see my dad was able to hear. I could tell he wasn’t yelling when he spoke. I could see him want to interact. I could tell it changed his life!

Since coming home, I no longer have to have the TV blaring. I no longer have to speak next to his ear. He can now talk on the phone!!! It’s been a real life changing experience and I cannot thank Dr Dusty enough.

So if you are in need of hearing care, I highly suggest you call and make an appointment. You will not be disappointed. Rob

reviews.author: Ken Harman
reviews.text: I have had two pair of Costco hearing aids in the past 3-4 years and until I came to Columbine Hearing I didn't realize how bad my hearing was.  After my 60 day appointment the difference in devices and the service received cannot be compared with Costco.  I had no clue of the complexity adjusting a device to fit an individuals hearing in each ear.  Dusty is the ultimate professional and I cannot give a higher recommendation to anyone considering hearing devices.  Thanks Dusty.  Ken

reviews.author: Erik A
reviews.text: I'm a disabled Veteran and was going to wait at least a month at the VA to fix my hearing aids...(My dog was hungry) Not only did they get me in same day, but went above and beyond. Thank you!

reviews.author: Joe Pollara
reviews.text: Dusty is attentive and on the ball. I highly recommend her to anyone needing help with their hearing issues.

reviews.author: Scott Papay
reviews.text:
I came into for a complete hearing exam due to recent challenges hearing intimate conversations, or softer voices at a distance in a quiet room.  I was really concerned at 52 that my hearing deteriorated from years of military service, power tools and loud music.  I was anticipating having to purchase hearing aids to correct my issue.

Brenda took great care of me and I felt at ease from the moment I arrived.  She carefully explained the testing protocols and process of the very thorough exam.  She took her time and was very patient with my questions.  I felt important in her unhurried thorough responses.

Afterwards, she spent time to carefully review the test results with me and explain them in detail and in simple terms I could understand.  In the end, my hearing loss ended up being minor enough that she said she had a hard time recommending hearing aids.  But she kindly offered to let me "test drive' a set to see if the difference was significant enough to warrant my desire to spend the $$$$.

In other words, this practice is one which operates with a very high degree of integrity in an industry which sometimes has a bit of a predatory reputation.

THANK YOU, THANK YOU for your care and honesty.  I cannot recommend this practice enough.  True, personal, caring experts who aren't out to make a quick buck.

** I found out also today that some ear buds (Airpod Pros) can be used to help amplify sounds and sort of act as hearing aids in situations such as mine.  I'm going to give those a try for now.

reviews.author: Helen Micek
reviews.text:
I want to highly recommend Dr. Dusty Jessen and Columbine Hearing Care.  IF I could give them 100+ stars, I would without hesitation.
I went went to seek information and help in navigating my hearing loss that was progressing and interfering with my quality of life. Not knowing what to expect, I was apprehensive, but Dr. Dusty immediately put me at ease listening to my concerns, evaluating my hearing loss and--best of all--offering solutions.
I now am the proud wearer of amazing hearing aids that have enhanced my world.
Dr. Dusty is the very best!  She gave me back a whole world that I was missing. I am forever grateful!

reviews.author: Dave Kline
reviews.text:
I am a full time RVer. One of our challenges while traveling is finding good healthcare providers. Today I was fortunate enough to find Dusty Jessen. I called on Thursday and she fit me in her schedule on Friday morning. That was my first positive thought. Secondly I recieved an email with accurate detailed directions.
Friday I arrived a few minutes early an was greeted by this lady with a wonderful smile and cheery welcome. Turns out it's Dusty.

I had a broken microphone on one of my aids. She was able to replace it under Warranty. Also she tested both of my aids and made adjustments that helped me tremendously. She was very thorough and professional in her questions and caring for my best interest.
I would highly recommend Dusty if your a contemplating you first pair of aids or considering a new pair. I don't believe you will be disappointed in your choice.

reviews.author: Kenneth Walsh
reviews.text: Dr. Dusty Jessen has been my audiologist for many years. I have what clinically is considered poor hearing. When I take my aids out I can’t hear anything.  She has changed my aids through the years to accommodate my hearing loss and issues.  Her decisions for me have insured continued quality of life and comfort with the changing hearing aid market.  Her office is warm and welcoming and uses state of the art methods and equipment. She has been WONDERFUL for me!

reviews.author: Chris Miller
reviews.text: Brenda and Dusty are the best.  They are knowledgeable, friendly, and very concerned about the clients needs.  They do not pressure you in any way.  They just want to let the client know what the options are so that the client can decide on the best personal option.   I used them for both hearing protection and hearing aids.  I would not go anywhere else!

reviews.author: marcia malisch
reviews.text: I have been going to Dr Dusty for many years. I am using my third pair of hearing aids. They get me in to the office promptly if I have a problem.

reviews.author: Tammi Marcell
reviews.text: Dusti from Columbine hearing who is partnered with Hearing The Call has done nothing less than give me my life back!!!! She was amazing to work with, understood my concerns and fears as well as assisted me with a brand new pair of hearing aids needed due to my disability, at ZERO cost to me since I had recently been laid off from the company I worked at for years. I was in an absolute destitute and defeated situation and this place is my new guardian angel!! Please do not hesitate or let fear hold you back if this is something that affects you or someone close to you, you or they could have their life back in such short easy steps. They really are there to help you!!!! Thank you for the help you have provided me, I truly cannot thank you enough!!

reviews.author: Mike Riegel
reviews.text:
Outstanding service:  Patient of Dr. Dusty for over 12 years.  She is professional yet friendly.  More than once she has come thru under tight time lines.  Had meetings out of town, hearing aid quite working two days before leaving.  She contacted hearing aid co. worked with them to try to fix the problem. No go.  Had to send it in.  She gave me a replacement, tuned it to my needs and it worked for the week.   Mine was there after I returned.   Excellent customer service.   Over time, Dr Dusty has answered my questions about new products available.  She researched the products and clearly explained whether they would work be an improvement or not.   No pressure to buy, just clear unbiased facts.   Fantastic.

Brenda has been helpful especially with a problem with fit which turned out to be ear wax issue.   Took care of that problem immediately.  Wonderful....

Highly recommend Columbine Hearing Care to any and all.

reviews.author: Tage Harding
reviews.text: So helpful, kind, and caring! My ears feel so much better!

reviews.author: Andrew Fletcher
reviews.text: I went in to get an ear cleaning. The service was so quick. I was in and out in about 20 minutes. The staff was super friendly! I would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Freddy Figallo
reviews.text: I've been going to Dr. Dusty for my hearing aids for many years.  I could not recommend her and her team enough.  They are very professional, friendly, and above all, very patient with all of my needs.  They've helped with with many hearing issues and have always been available to answer all my questions and concerns.  I would not trust anyone else with my hearing.  Period. When it was time for new hearing aids, Dr. Dusty made sure we tried different ones that fit my budget and that addressed my needs.  We landed on an amazing pair, and I am really enjoying the experience.  Thank you, Columbine Hearing Care for taking great care of your patients and for all your charity work!

reviews.author: Giles Ober
reviews.text: Excellent service! Dusty took molds of my ears for the purpose of ordering custom in-ear monitors (I'm a musician). She cleaned my ears before doing the molds. I'm blown away by how much better I can hear. Dusty was professional, friendly, and made me feel welcomed from the moment I walked in. A true thought leader in her field! Don't hesitate to book your appointment!

reviews.author: Jonathan Joy
reviews.text: I went 2 weeks with a clogged ear and I had no idea this process would be so easy. I had a fantastic experience at Columbine Hearing Care. Friendly staff and very informative with every step of the cleaning process. I felt like I was hearing in high definition when I was done. I wish I had done it sooner!

reviews.author: Paul Clapper
reviews.text: My brother was having issues with his hearing aids and I contacted Brenda.  She spent time checking the problem, contacted the manufacturer and offered two solutions.  Great service.

reviews.author: Connor Wooley
reviews.text: I had a plugged ear for almost 2 weeks. It took about 5 mins and I was good as new. She was very friendly and professional. I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Claire Tanner
reviews.text: Dr Dusty was kind, friendly and very efficient! She explained exactly what was going on at every step of my procedure and I would definitely return for additional hearing and ear treatment.

reviews.author: Brion Black
reviews.text: Beyond any expectation. Professional and caring ☺️

reviews.author: B A
reviews.text: I met with Brenda to discuss custom ear molds.  She took time to really understand what I was looking for.  I really appreciated her willingness to help me with research and walk me through my best options.

reviews.author: Frank Marek
reviews.text:
I've been a serious hifi enthusiast all my life.  I was fearful the aids would diminish the enjoyment.  Turns out, just the opposite.  (And so easily tested--just take them out once in a while.)
Brenda is great--expert at her profession.  I and the whole family thank her.
Whose dog?  Looks like truly man's best friend.  Breed?
Frank M.

reviews.author: Susan Hajec
reviews.text: Dr Dusty and Brenda have given me outstanding information, education, service and follow up since I received my hearing aids from them.  They are very knowledgeable in the field of hearing loss and how to treat it to meet specific needs and wants.  I am very happy with Columbine Hearing Care and highly recommend them for personalized hearing loss care.

reviews.author: Brock Taylor
reviews.text: I am very impressed by Brenda & Dr. Dusty's total commitment to care and education. I have total confidence in their practice!

reviews.author: James Rice
reviews.text: I was in Colorado on vacation when my right hearing aid failed. My father -- who is a regular patient of CHC -- secured a courtesy appointment for me the same afternoon with Brenda. Without even being a patient of the practice, Brenda repaired my hearing aid, saved my vacation, and didn't charge me a penny for it. That is patient care and customer service on a level that is unheard of. Thank you, Brenda, and CHC, for being so awesome -- this is why my father is a patient at your practice and not somewhere else.

reviews.author: P G
reviews.text:
Oh my goodness, if you have a need for hearing aids you should run not walk, not hesitate, no delay in going to to Dr Dusty Jessen or Brenda Garcia at Columbine Hearing Care.

I have know Dusty for over 10 years when she worked at an area ENT's office and I developed early hearing loss. Unfortunately I did not buy my first hearing aids thru her because my insurance was not accepted at the ENT's office. Now that I am needing a second set of hearing aids (yes, I waited way toooo long to get the 2nd pair) I have returned to the most patient, thorough, flexible, current, competent and generally affordable office given the service that you receive. My new pair of Aids have a much more custom fit, my hearing is more keen and all at a lower cost than I spent 10 years ago for a lesser product.

Columbine Hearing can perform hearing tests, test the pressure in your ears, help set you up with phone apps to use your bluetooth with your hearing aid or turn it off. If current technology is not your desire they can supply you with the good old fashion battery operated aids. Dusty and Brenda have 'test' aids that you can try which is incredibly helpful given the variability of hearing environments and hearing loss. I just wish my family lived in town to share them with this wonderful office.

My advice is to be kind to yourself because this is a journey and it isn't accomplished in a visit or even two or three. You need commited professionals to see you through this very vulnerable process, I recommend Dusty and Brenda without hesitation!

reviews.author: Mellissa Baskall
reviews.text: My husband, David, is so happy with his new hearing aides (and so am I)!  Dr. Dusty Jessen and Brenda Garcia went above and beyond to give unhurried individual attention to David and his hearing needs. They were kind and thorough in their explanations.  We really appreciated the time and attention to detail in working with Dr. Dusty and Brenda. We highly recommend Columbine Hearing Care to everyone we know!

reviews.author: Keith Logan
reviews.text: I’ve been with Dr.Dusty for about 20 years and would NEVER go anywhere else.She has ALWAYS been there to help,and the products as well as service has been 100% A1 professional all the way !

reviews.author: Justin Enos
reviews.text: Dr. Jessen is awesome! Thank you so much for all of your help!

reviews.author: Shawna Fisch
reviews.text: Dr. Dusty is the absolute best of the best. She gives her clients her complete attention; is so personable, kind and responsive; and truly wants to enhance the lives of those she serves. In addition, her generous heart is seen in her service work of providing audiology services in Guatemala. She also has a beautiful office in Littleton which is very warm and welcoming. I highly recommend Dusty for any one in need of her services as well as their loved ones whose lives could be so greatly impacted by improvements to their hearing.

reviews.author: E A M
reviews.text: I definitely had a five-star experience at Columbine Hearing Care. Dr. Dusty Jessen is an expert audiologist and a caring, conscientious person. Her prices are comparatively low, and the service she provided was better than I had experienced with my previous provider. Furthermore, I had never received followups about how I was doing with my hearing aids after I purchased them. I highly recommend Columbine Hearing Care. It is state of the art hearing care.

reviews.author: John Phillips
reviews.text:
If you find you are starting to have hearing issues or just want a baseline done of your hearing, I'd highly recommend Columbine Hearing Care.
Dr. Jessen was friendly, engaging, answered all my questions and spent as much time as I needed.

I also had my son go with me to get fitted for custom fit ear protection. An easy 15 minute process that will end up with him having much better hearing protection than you can find off-the-shelf.

Thanks Dr Jessen!
